name: date-range-picker
title: Date Range Picker
description: Choose the beginning and end of a date interval in an inline or floating calendar.

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  computed,
  nextTick,
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onMounted,
  ref,
  watch,
} from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { SPRING_PRESS } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
const props = defineProps<{
  id: string;
  label: string;
  choices: { id: string; label: string; disabled: boolean }[];
  selected: string;
  focusOnMount: boolean;
  reduce: boolean;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ select: [id: string]; close: [] }>();
const root = ref<HTMLFieldSetElement | null>(null);
const cursor = ref<string | null>(props.selected);
const active = computed(
  () =>
    [cursor.value, props.selected].find((id) =>
      props.choices.some((choice) => choice.id === id && !choice.disabled),
    ) ?? props.choices.find((choice) => !choice.disabled)?.id,
);
let disposed = false,
  revision = 0;
async function focus() {
  const version = ++revision;
  if (!props.focusOnMount) return;
  await nextTick();
  if (!disposed && version === revision)
    root.value
      ?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button[tabindex="0"]')
      ?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
}
onMounted(focus);
watch(() => props.focusOnMount, focus);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  disposed = true;
  ++revision;
});
function key(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (event.defaultPrevented || event.altKey || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey)
    return;
  if (event.key === "Escape") {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    emit("close");
    return;
  }
  const buttons = [
    ...(root.value?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("button") ?? []),
  ];
  const offset = (
    { ArrowLeft: -1, ArrowRight: 1, ArrowUp: -3, ArrowDown: 3 } as Record<
      string,
      number
    >
  )[event.key];
  let index =
    event.key === "Home"
      ? 0
      : event.key === "End"
        ? buttons.length - 1
        : offset === undefined
          ? -1
          : buttons.indexOf(event.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement) + offset;
  if (offset === undefined && event.key !== "Home" && event.key !== "End")
    return;
  event.preventDefault();
  const direction =
    offset === undefined ? (event.key === "Home" ? 1 : -1) : Math.sign(offset);
  while (index >= 0 && index < buttons.length && buttons[index]!.disabled)
    index += direction;
  buttons[index]?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
}
</script>
<template>
  <fieldset
    ref="root"
    :id="id"
    :aria-label="label"
    class="grid min-h-[15.25rem] grid-cols-3 content-start gap-2 border-0 p-0 pt-1"
  >
    <motion.button
      v-for="choice in choices"
      :key="choice.id"
      type="button"
      :disabled="choice.disabled"
      :aria-pressed="choice.id === selected"
      :tabindex="choice.id === active ? 0 : -1"
      :while-press="reduce ? undefined : { scale: 0.96 }"
      :transition="SPRING_PRESS"
      :class="
        cn(
          'flex h-13 items-center justify-center rounded-xl px-1 text-[13px] tabular-nums transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:opacity-25',
          choice.id === selected
            ? 'bg-foreground font-medium text-background'
            : 'bg-muted/40 hover:bg-muted',
        )
      "
      @focus="cursor = choice.id"
      @keydown="key"
      @click="emit('select', choice.id)"
      >{{ choice.label }}</motion.button
    >
  </fieldset>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { provide } from "vue";
import { MorphPopover } from "../../popover";
import { createDateRangePicker, type DateRangeOptions } from "./controller";
import DateRangePickerCalendar from "./DateRangePickerCalendar.vue";
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<DateRangeOptions>(), {
  open: undefined,
  defaultValue: null,
  locale: "en-US",
  label: "Choose a date range",
  showSummary: true,
  defaultOpen: false,
  closeOnSelect: false,
});
const emit = defineEmits([
  "update:modelValue",
  "valueChange",
  "change",
  "update:open",
  "openChange",
]);
const state = createDateRangePicker(props, emit);
provide("orvui-date-range", state);
</script>
<template>
  <MorphPopover
    :open="state.open.value"
    class="max-w-full"
    @update:open="state.setOpen"
    ><slot
      :value="state.value.value"
      :select-date="state.select"
      :clear="state.clear"
      ><DateRangePickerCalendar /></slot
  ></MorphPopover>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject } from "vue";
import type { createDateRangePicker } from "./controller";
const props = defineProps<{ disabled?: boolean }>();
const state =
  inject<ReturnType<typeof createDateRangePicker>>("orvui-date-range")!;
const blocked = computed(
  () => props.disabled || !state.value.value || state.props.disabled,
);
function clear() {
  if (!blocked.value) state.clear();
}
</script>
<template>
  <button
    type="button"
    aria-label="Clear date range"
    :disabled="blocked"
    @click="clear"
    class="rounded-md px-1.5 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:opacity-30"
  >
    <slot>Clear</slot>
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
import { inject, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, watch } from "vue";
import { MorphPopoverContent } from "../../popover";
import type { createDateRangePicker } from "./controller";
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    autoFocus?: boolean;
    onOpenAutoFocus?: (content: HTMLDivElement) => void;
  }>(),
  { autoFocus: true },
);
const state =
  inject<ReturnType<typeof createDateRangePicker>>("orvui-date-range")!;
let revision = 0,
  disposed = false;
async function focus(panel: HTMLDivElement) {
  state.content.value = panel;
  const version = ++revision;
  await nextTick();
  if (disposed || version !== revision || !state.open.value) return;
  if (props.autoFocus) {
    const grid = [...panel.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="grid"]')].find(
      (node) => !node.closest("[inert]"),
    );
    (grid?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button[tabindex="0"]') ?? grid)?.focus({
      preventScroll: true,
    });
  }
  props.onOpenAutoFocus?.(panel);
}
watch(state.open, async (opened) => {
  ++revision;
  if (!opened || !props.autoFocus) return;
  await nextTick();
  if (state.content.value && !disposed)
    void focus(state.content.value as HTMLDivElement);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  disposed = true;
  ++revision;
});
</script>
<template>
  <MorphPopoverContent
    v-bind="$attrs"
    align="start"
    :radius="16"
    :shadow="false"
    class="w-80 max-w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)]"
    :on-open-auto-focus="focus"
    ><slot
  /></MorphPopoverContent>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DateRangeOptions } from "./controller";
import DateRangePicker from "./DateRangePicker.vue";
import DateRangePickerTrigger from "./DateRangePickerTrigger.vue";
import DateRangePickerContent from "./DateRangePickerContent.vue";
import DateRangePickerCalendar from "./DateRangePickerCalendar.vue";
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<
    DateRangeOptions & {
      placeholder?: string;
      triggerClassName?: string;
      calendarClassName?: string;
    }
  >(),
  { open: undefined, autoFocus: true, showSummary: false },
);
const emit = defineEmits([
  "update:modelValue",
  "valueChange",
  "change",
  "update:open",
  "openChange",
]);
</script>
<template>
  <DateRangePicker
    v-bind="props"
    @update:model-value="emit('update:modelValue', $event)"
    @value-change="emit('valueChange', $event)"
    @change="emit('change', $event)"
    @update:open="emit('update:open', $event)"
    @open-change="emit('openChange', $event)"
    ><DateRangePickerTrigger
      :placeholder="placeholder"
      :class="triggerClassName" /><DateRangePickerContent
      :auto-focus="autoFocus"
      ><DateRangePickerCalendar
        :class="[
          'w-full rounded-none border-0',
          calendarClassName,
        ]" /></DateRangePickerContent
  ></DateRangePicker>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { h, mergeProps, renderSlot, useAttrs } from "vue";
import DateRangePickerSelection from "./DateRangePickerSelection.vue";
import DateRangePickerClear from "./DateRangePickerClear.vue";
import DateRangePickerPresets from "./DateRangePickerPresets.vue";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const slots = defineSlots<{ default?(props: {}): any }>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const summaryParts = [DateRangePickerSelection, DateRangePickerClear] as const;
const defaultContent = () => [
  h(
    "div",
    { class: "flex items-center justify-between gap-2" },
    summaryParts.map((part) => h(part)),
  ),
  h(DateRangePickerPresets),
];
const RenderFrame = () =>
  h(
    "div",
    mergeProps({ class: "mt-2.5 border-t border-border pt-2.5" }, attrs),
    [renderSlot(slots, "default", {}, defaultContent)],
  );
</script>
<template><RenderFrame /></template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, ref } from "vue";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import type { DateRange } from "./types";
import type { createDateRangePicker } from "./controller";
const props = defineProps<{
  value: DateRange;
  label?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}>();
const state =
  inject<ReturnType<typeof createDateRangePicker>>("orvui-date-range")!;
const root = ref<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
const selected = computed(
  () =>
    state.value.value?.from === props.value.from &&
    state.value.value?.to === props.value.to,
);
function choose() {
  if (!props.disabled && state.rangeAvailable(props.value))
    state.selectPreset(
      props.value,
      props.label ?? root.value?.textContent?.trim() ?? "Preset",
    );
}
</script>
<template>
  <button
    ref="root"
    type="button"
    :aria-label="label"
    :aria-pressed="selected"
    :disabled="disabled || !state.rangeAvailable(value)"
    @click="choose"
    :class="
      cn(
        'rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:opacity-40',
        selected
          ? 'bg-foreground text-background'
          : 'bg-muted/60 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground',
      )
    "
  >
    <slot>{{ label }}</slot>
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
import { computed, inject } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { CalendarDays, ChevronDown } from "lucide-vue-next";
import { SPRING_LAYOUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { resolveElement } from "../../../lib/composables";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { MorphPopoverTrigger } from "../../popover";
import type { createDateRangePicker } from "./controller";
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{ placeholder?: string; disabled?: boolean }>(),
  { placeholder: "Select dates" },
);
const state =
  inject<ReturnType<typeof createDateRangePicker>>("orvui-date-range")!;
const summary = computed(() => {
  const range = state.value.value;
  if (!range) return props.placeholder;
  const sameYear = range.to && range.from.slice(0, 4) === range.to.slice(0, 4);
  return `${state.format(range.from, { month: "short", day: "numeric", ...(sameYear ? {} : { year: "numeric" }) })} – ${range.to ? state.format(range.to, { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }) : "Select end"}`;
});
const layout = computed(() => (state.reduce.value ? false : "position"));
</script>
<template>
  <MorphPopoverTrigger
    ><motion.button
      v-bind="$attrs"
      :ref="(node) => (state.anchor.value = resolveElement<HTMLElement>(node))"
      type="button"
      :disabled="props.disabled || state.props.disabled"
      :layout="!state.reduce.value"
      :transition="{ layout: SPRING_LAYOUT }"
      :style="{ borderRadius: '12px' }"
      :aria-label="
        String($attrs['aria-label'] ?? `${state.props.label}: ${summary}`)
      "
      :class="
        cn(
          'inline-flex h-9 w-fit max-w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-[13px] font-medium text-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-muted/40 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:opacity-40',
          $attrs.class as string,
        )
      "
      ><motion.span
        v-if="$slots.default"
        :layout="layout"
        :transition="{ layout: SPRING_LAYOUT }"
        class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2"
        ><slot /></motion.span
      ><template v-else
        ><motion.span
          :layout="layout"
          :transition="{ layout: SPRING_LAYOUT }"
          class="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground"
          aria-hidden="true"
          ><CalendarDays :size="15" /></motion.span
        ><motion.span
          :layout="layout"
          :transition="{ layout: SPRING_LAYOUT }"
          class="min-w-0 truncate tabular-nums"
          >{{ summary }}</motion.span
        ><motion.span
          :layout="layout"
          :transition="{ layout: SPRING_LAYOUT }"
          class="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground"
          aria-hidden="true"
          ><ChevronDown
            :size="13"
            :class="
              state.open.value ? 'rotate-180' : undefined
            " /></motion.span></template></motion.button
  ></MorphPopoverTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
import {
  computed,
  nextTick,
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onMounted,
  ref,
  watch,
  type Ref,
} from "vue";
import { animate, motion, motionValue, useTransform } from "motion-v";
import { EASE_OUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { resolveElement } from "../../../lib/composables";
import { usePopover, usePortalPosition } from "./context";
import { createMorphFocus } from "./morph-focus";
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    side?: "top" | "bottom";
    align?: "start" | "end";
    sideOffset?: number;
    radius?: number;
    shadow?: boolean;
    initialFocus?: HTMLElement | Ref<HTMLElement | null> | null;
    onOpenAutoFocus?: (content: HTMLDivElement) => void;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { side: "bottom", align: "end", sideOffset: 8, radius: 16, shadow: true },
);
const state = usePopover();
const mounted = ref(false);
const present = ref(state.open.value);
const panel = ref<unknown>(null);
const measured = computed({
  get: () => resolveElement<HTMLElement>(panel.value),
  set: (value) => {
    panel.value = value;
  },
});
const layout = usePortalPosition(
  state.anchor,
  measured,
  computed(() => mounted.value && state.open.value),
);
const progress = motionValue(0);
const fade = motionValue(state.reduce.value ? 0 : 1);
const focus = createMorphFocus(
  props,
  () => state.open.value && !!layout.value,
  state.takeFocusOnOpen,
);
watch(
  panel,
  (value) => {
    state.content.value = resolveElement<HTMLElement>(value);
  },
  { flush: "post" },
);
const placement = computed(() => {
  const box = layout.value;
  if (!box) return { left: 0, top: 0, side: props.side, available: 0 };
  const gutter = 12;
  const free = {
    bottom: Math.max(
      0,
      window.innerHeight -
        box.trigger.top -
        box.trigger.height -
        props.sideOffset -
        gutter,
    ),
    top: Math.max(0, box.trigger.top - props.sideOffset - gutter),
  };
  const alternative = props.side === "top" ? "bottom" : "top";
  const side =
    box.content.height > free[props.side] &&
    free[alternative] > free[props.side]
      ? alternative
      : props.side;
  const preferred =
    box.trigger.left +
    (props.align === "end" ? box.trigger.width - box.content.width : 0);
  return {
    left: Math.max(
      gutter,
      Math.min(preferred, window.innerWidth - box.content.width - gutter),
    ),
    top:
      side === "bottom"
        ? box.trigger.top + box.trigger.height + props.sideOffset
        : Math.max(
            gutter,
            box.trigger.top - box.content.height - props.sideOffset,
          ),
    side,
    available: free[side],
  };
});
const clipPath = useTransform(() => {
  const inset = 92 * (1 - progress.get());
  return `inset(${placement.value.side === "top" ? inset : 0}% ${props.align === "start" ? inset : 0}% ${placement.value.side === "bottom" ? inset : 0}% ${props.align === "end" ? inset : 0}% round ${props.radius}px)`;
});
const opacity = useTransform(progress, [0, 0.15], [0, 1]);
let animation: ReturnType<typeof animate> | undefined;
let revision = 0;
let disposed = false;
function run() {
  animation?.stop();
  if (!mounted.value || !layout.value || disposed) return;
  const version = ++revision;
  const opened = state.open.value;
  const done = () => {
    if (!disposed && version === revision && !opened && !state.open.value)
      present.value = false;
  };
  if (state.reduce.value) {
    progress.jump(1);
    animation = animate(fade, opened ? 1 : 0, {
      duration: 0.12,
      onComplete: done,
    });
  } else
    animation = animate(progress, opened ? 1 : 0, {
      ...(opened
        ? { type: "spring", duration: 0.26, bounce: 0 }
        : { duration: 0.2, ease: EASE_OUT }),
      onComplete: done,
    });
  void focus.focus(state.content.value);
}
watch(
  state.open,
  async (opened) => {
    focus.reset();
    ++revision;
    if (opened) {
      layout.value = null;
      progress.jump(0);
      fade.jump(state.reduce.value ? 0 : 1);
      present.value = true;
      await nextTick();
    }
    run();
  },
  { flush: "post" },
);
watch(
  () => !!layout.value,
  (ready) => {
    if (ready) run();
  },
  { flush: "post" },
);
onMounted(() => {
  mounted.value = true;
  present.value = state.open.value;
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  disposed = true;
  ++revision;
  animation?.stop();
  progress.destroy();
  fade.destroy();
  state.content.value = null;
});
</script>
<template>
  <Teleport v-if="mounted" to="body"
    ><motion.div
      v-if="present"
      data-morph-popover-portal=""
      :inert="!state.open.value"
      :style="{
        left: placement.left + 'px',
        top: placement.top + 'px',
        opacity: state.reduce.value ? fade : opacity,
        pointerEvents: state.open.value ? 'auto' : 'none',
        visibility: layout ? 'visible' : 'hidden',
      }"
      :class="[
        'fixed z-[9999]',
        shadow
          ? '[filter:drop-shadow(0_10px_18px_rgba(0,0,0,0.14))]'
          : undefined,
      ]"
      ><motion.div
        ref="panel"
        v-bind="$attrs"
        :id="state.contentId"
        role="dialog"
        :aria-labelledby="state.triggerId"
        tabindex="-1"
        :style="{
          clipPath: state.reduce.value ? undefined : clipPath,
          borderRadius: props.radius + 'px',
          maxHeight: layout ? placement.available + 'px' : undefined,
          overflowX: 'hidden',
          overflowY: 'auto',
        }"
        :class="
          cn(
            'overflow-hidden border border-border bg-background outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-ring',
            $attrs.class as string,
            className,
          )
        "
        ><slot /></motion.div></motion.div
  ></Teleport>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import PopoverTrigger from "./PopoverTrigger.vue";
export default PopoverTrigger;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
import {
  Comment,
  Fragment,
  Text,
  cloneVNode,
  defineComponent,
  h,
  onBeforeUnmount,
  type VNode,
} from "vue";
import { resolveElement } from "../../../lib/composables";
import { usePopover } from "./context";
function flatten(nodes: VNode[]): VNode[] {
  return nodes.flatMap((node) =>
    node.type === Fragment
      ? flatten(node.children as VNode[])
      : node.type === Comment
        ? []
        : [node],
  );
}
export default defineComponent({
  name: "PopoverTrigger",
  inheritAttrs: false,
  setup(_, { attrs, slots }) {
    const state = usePopover();
    let keyboard = false;
    let contact: { kind: string; opened: boolean } | undefined;
    onBeforeUnmount(() => {
      state.trigger.value = null;
    });
    const click = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
      if (state.kind === "morph") {
        state.armFocusOnOpen(
          !state.open.value && keyboard && event.detail === 0,
        );
        keyboard = false;
        state.toggle();
      } else if (state.p.trigger !== "hover") state.toggle();
      else {
        const gesture = contact;
        contact = undefined;
        if (gesture && gesture.kind !== "mouse") state.setOpen(!gesture.opened);
      }
    };
    return () => {
      const nodes = flatten(slots.default?.() ?? []);
      const child =
        nodes.length === 1 && nodes[0]!.type !== Text
          ? nodes[0]!
          : h(
              "button",
              {
                type: "button",
                class:
                  "inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-border bg-background px-4 py-2 text-sm",
              },
              nodes,
            );
      return cloneVNode(
        child,
        {
          ...attrs,
          ref: (node: unknown) => {
            state.trigger.value = resolveElement<HTMLElement>(node);
          },
          id: state.triggerId,
          "aria-haspopup": "dialog",
          "aria-expanded": state.open.value,
          "aria-controls": state.open.value ? state.contentId : undefined,
          "data-state": state.open.value ? "open" : "closed",
          class: [
            attrs.class,
            state.kind === "goo" ? "relative z-0" : undefined,
          ],
          onPointerdown: (event: PointerEvent) => {
            keyboard = false;
            contact = { kind: event.pointerType, opened: state.open.value };
          },
          onPointercancel: () => {
            contact = undefined;
          },
          onKeydown: (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
            contact = undefined;
            keyboard = event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ";
          },
          onFocus: (event: FocusEvent) => {
            if (
              !event.defaultPrevented &&
              state.kind === "goo" &&
              state.p.trigger === "hover"
            )
              state.openHover();
          },
          onBlur: (event: FocusEvent) => {
            if (
              !event.defaultPrevented &&
              state.kind === "goo" &&
              state.p.trigger === "hover"
            )
              state.scheduleClose();
          },
          onClick: click,
        },
        true,
      );
    };
  },
});
</script>
